conceptDrafts.logline: A washed-up rodeo fixer takes one last debt-clearing job — babysitting the teenage daughter of the man he's being paid to betray.

settings.toneNote: dark humor under everything — find the funny in the bleak, never goofy

concept.summary: Ray Dellum used to make problems disappear for rodeo promoters. Now he owes the wrong man forty grand. The payoff job is simple: keep Cass Harlan's sixteen-year-old daughter occupied for a weekend while Ray's employer guts her father's business. But the kid is smarter than every adult in her orbit, and by Sunday Ray has to choose which debt he can live with.
themes: the cost of one last job

characters.name: Ray Dellum
characters.backstory: Twenty years cleaning up after rodeo money. One bad season of gambling put him under Judd Coyle's thumb.
characters.want: Out of Coyle's ledger by Monday.
characters.need: To stop settling other people's accounts and pay his own.
characters.voice: spare, dry, jokes at the worst possible moment
characters.arc: From hired blank to a man who picks a side.

characters.name: Lena Harlan
characters.backstory: Sixteen, raised in the back offices of her father's stockyard empire.
characters.motivations: Figure out why a stranger is suddenly her chaperone.
characters.need: One adult who doesn't lie to her.
characters.arc: From playing adults against each other to trusting one.

characters.name: Judd Coyle
characters.backstory: Owns half the county's paper, including Ray's.
characters.motivations: Take Harlan's stockyards without a court ever hearing about it.
characters.flaws: Believes every man prices out like cattle.

beats.name: Ledger Day
beats.summary: Ray watches Coyle bankrupt a friend over coffee, then gets handed his own 'last job.'
beats.purpose: Establish the debt world and the price of staying neutral.

beats.name: The Babysit
beats.summary: Ray meets Lena; she clocks him as hired muscle in under a minute.
beats.purpose: Collision of the two leads; she's ahead of him.

beats.name: Wrong Errand
beats.summary: A pickup Ray runs for Coyle turns out to be surveillance gear aimed at Harlan's books.
beats.purpose: Ray can no longer pretend the job is harmless.

beats.name: Lena's Price
beats.summary: Lena catches Ray mid-lie and offers a trade: her silence for the truth.
beats.purpose: Reverse the leverage; the kid holds the cards.

beats.name: Which Debt
beats.summary: Coyle calls the job done and the debt clear — if Ray walks away right now.
beats.purpose: Force the choice the whole film has been pricing.
